title: How Well Do You Know Maya?
subtitle: Class of 2026. This is a sample game about a made-up graduate, so guess away.

questions.q: What did Maya want to be when she was 6?
questions.fact: She wore a cardboard space helmet to school for most of first grade.

questions.q: What was Maya's go-to Friday night dinner all through high school?
questions.fact: Her dad made them every Friday from freshman year on. She has never once skipped the salsa.

questions.q: At 8, Maya ran a lemonade stand all summer. How much did she make?
questions.fact: She charged extra for 'premium ice'. Nobody knows what made it premium.

questions.q: Which one was Maya's first car?
questions.fact: Grandma's old minivan, nicknamed The Blue Whale. It fit the whole volleyball team.

questions.q: What sport did Maya letter in?
What is Maya's most-played song of all time?
questions.fact: The 'How Far I'll Go' replay count is honestly concerning.

questions.q: What is the name of the family dog?
Which teacher did Maya say changed her life?
questions.fact: Mr. Patel's chemistry class is the reason she is studying nursing.

questions.q: Where is Maya headed this fall?
What does Maya always order at a coffee shop?
questions.fact: Twelve months a year. Even in July. With extra whipped cream.
